import subprocess
# Check if dateutil.tz.UTC exists and is equivalent to tzutc()
result = subprocess.run(["python", "-c", 
    "from dateutil import tz; print(type(tz.UTC)); print(tz.UTC == tz.tzutc()); print(repr(tz.UTC))"], 
    capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
